title: Completion model cost
statement: For a block and seed in a three-element set, a known sign, and an input sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^9$, the completion model cost is $1$ if the known sign equals the recursive input block of $x$ at that block and at the cyclic-majority second coordinate determined by the seed; otherwise it is $2$.
hypotheses_covered: block is an element of a three-element set
seed is an element of a three-element set
x is a sign vector of length nine
